why: A bookkeeping simulation: sum every amount, then group card payments (negative amounts) by month in a hash map of (count, total) and charge the 5 fee for every one of the twelve months that does not reach 3 payments and 100 total.
hints: The balance is just the sum of all amounts minus the fees; the only real work is deciding which months are waived.
Key a dictionary by month (characters 5-6 of the date) and keep the number and the absolute total of negative transactions.
Loop over all 12 months, not just those that appear, subtracting 5 unless count >= 3 and total >= 100. O(n).
pitfalls: Months with no transactions still pay the fee.
Positive amounts never count toward the waiver.
Both conditions are needed: three small payments under 100 total do not waive the fee.
